rv.q: With this revival, and conductor Nimrod David Pfeffer’s excellent attention to musical details, the Met Opera played it smart and showcased a stellar cast that kept you on the edge of your seat.
Wednesday's season premiere of Così fan tutte confirmed that it's one of the most satisfying watches out of the bunch.

cn.t: McDermott's vibrant Coney Island-set production returns with a striking 1950s aesthetic that divides critics—some find the concept enhances Mozart's improbable plot, while musical execution receives mixed praise.
